visual_qa: Full-image review plus representative detail crops at 200%; no project previews kept.

images.initial_prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an additional location key, exactly 1536x1024 landscape PNG at native resolution, full-bleed single image.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED closed underground shopping arcade: match its grey concrete piers, attached black ceiling pipes, dusty dry speckled terrazzo, lowered blue-grey shutters and blank rectangular signboards. Input image 2 is the APPROVED granary: use its restrained ink, amber-dusk versus slate-violet colour balance and drawn stone handling as style continuity only; its medieval stone silos are INSIDE the portal and must not appear in the modern street.
Draw the arcade's street exit stairs in Hapjeong, at dusk. Establishing view from just inside the bottom landing, camera 1.6m above that landing, looking gently up the real staircase toward a small visible street opening. A broad straight flight of concrete stairs rises about one storey to the pavement, with attached steel handrails on both sides, 18cm risers, 1.1m railings and coherent perspective. The foreground is the same underground arcade as image 1: dry dusty terrazzo landing, a closed shutter at the frame edge, concrete retaining walls, black utility pipes, one cool-white fluorescent fitting above the lower landing. The stairs lead out to an ordinary Seoul low-rise street silhouette and a pale warm dusk band under a slate-blue sky; street shop signboards remain entirely blank. Warm low dusk light from the street opening is the key source, reaching down onto the top steps and one stair wall; the enclosed lower landing keeps the reference's cool fluorescent/slate-grey light. Matte concrete, no wet mirror floor. One tiny distant generic adult on the far street pavement for scale, normal 7.5-head body and long legs; no foreground person. Clear attached steps, rails, level street pavement at the head of the flight. Full background detail as a location reference, clean large shadow shapes. No portal needs to be in this reverse exit view, no fantasy architecture, no extra stairs branching at impossible angles. Crisp lossless image, no compression blocks or upscaled softness.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
